notes:
Account summary: mid-size retail search/recommendation platform evaluating Redwood to replace incumbent AtlasOps. POC focused on product search reranking + structured attribute extraction. Customer is risk-averse — downstream ETL consumes strict JSON schema.

Timeline / recent activities:
- 2025-10-05: Intro discovery call (Leah, Marco + Head of Search). POC proposal agreed; customer emphasized 'must be strict schema' for attributes. (ff_2025-10-05_3a9f)
- 2025-11-12: POC kickoff — dataset ingestion, scoped 2-week eval, SSO questionnaire submitted (drive:/Redwood/security/peregrine_security_faq.docx).
- 2026-01-18: Mid-POC review demo — observed issues: inconsistent structured output fields ("size" sometimes returned as string/number/null), tool-calling to product-catalog API failed on 23% of calls, model hallucinations on category mapping. Customer flagged this as regression vs AtlasOps. (ff_2026-01-18_7b9a)
- 2026-02-07: Security review redline — require organization SOC2 plus KMS/HSM for key separation; raised Jira SEC-3221. Procurement put hold pending legal review.
- 2026-02-14: Final evaluation demo — customer reported vendor selected Vendetta.ai citing better structured JSON guarantees and native tool-calling reliability. Quote from Head of Search: 'We can't risk downstream ETL breaking mid-holiday season.' Decision communicated verbally; procurement freeze + Head of ML departure removed internal champion.
- 2026-02-25: AE follow-up email; no response. Attempted exec intro; unresponsive.

Use-case & technical notes:
- Primary workload: reranking + product attribute extraction for real-time search responses at 200 qps peak.
- Latency requirement: P95 < 120ms for search path.
- Throughput target: 150-250 qps sustained.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high (willing to commit for reliability guarantees).
- Model preferences: curated open model with deterministic structured output and reliable tool-calling.
- Observed failure modes during POC: schema drift in generated JSON, intermittent tool-call timeouts, some outputs required heavy post-processing to fit downstream pipelines (unacceptable).

Decision drivers / why lost:
- Quality regression vs incumbent: customer observed that Redwood's POC runs produced inconsistent structured outputs compared to AtlasOps baseline; required extra engineering to sanitize outputs.
- Tool-calling reliability: Vendetta.ai demonstrated robust tool-calling orchestration and end-to-end API wiring in their demo.
- Security & compliance: request for org-level SOC2 + KMS increased procurement friction; customer prioritized vendor with faster compliance path.
- Organizational: hiring freeze and Head of ML departure — no internal champion to push for exceptions.

Next steps / recommended playbook:
- Mark as closed-lost; set reminder to re-engage in Q3 2026 when budgets/hiring may reopen.
- Provide post-mortem to product team: prioritize structured-output stability (schema enforcement, output validators) and tool-calling resilience for retail reranking workloads.
- Send lightweight one-pager on 'Guaranteed Structured Output' and a short case study on tool-calling reliability to Leah + Marco in 90 days.
